svg.font-family: -apple-system, system-ui, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: Time runs left to right. At each of three times the data gives a few unpaired observations, drawn as blue dots, with short dashed stubs through them standing for the trajectory that cannot be observed. Three gold trajectories start on observations and are generated forward by repeating one local update. The generated distribution is shown both apart from the observed one and matched to it.

g.text: at t2, and at every observed time
One update rule, applied everywhere and always in the same way
Every cell reads features from its own 3×3
neighbourhood, passes them through one small
shared network, and is updated by the result.
The same NCAθacts at every cell and every step,
so one rule has to account for the whole trajectory.
the same θ at every cell and every step
Using the standard GAN adversarial game, the discriminator
ensures that the snapshots from the generated trajectories
match the observed ones at all available times.
This procedure doesn't require the entire real trajectory to
be observed, making it perfectly suitable for our setting.
Training drives the generated distribution onto the observed one at each time.
